summary: Comprehensive QA of on-premise Local Tesseract OCR pipeline for scanned raster-only PDFs. Backend: all 15 pytest tests across test_ocr_pipeline.py (5), test_redaction_pipeline.py (3) and test_api_e2e.py (7) pass in 16.6s (parallel via xdist). OCR coverage validated: (1) raster-only PDF has no native text layer, (2) Tesseract detects DNI 54321987M + email maria.santos@example.test with bounding boxes, (3) physical raster-pixel destruction (raster_pixels_destroyed=True), (4) post-purge OCR re-verification confirms sensitive strings unrecoverable and ocr_reverification_passed=True, (5) rotated 90deg scanned page detected and purged, (6) rejected entity flow preserved via approved/rejected split. Frontend (Playwright 1440x900) full e2e: qa-fixtures-btn -> DevFixturesModal shows both scanned raster fixture (Informe Medico Escaneado - PDF Raster/OCR) and rotated fixture (Certificado Rotado). Loaded scanned fixture -> 6 OCR-detected entities (DNI/EMAIL/PHONE x2/ADDRESS - all with 'Fuente: ocr + regex' source label) -> accept-all -> confirm purge -> ResultsScreen shows 'Purga Verificada con Exito' badge, SHA-256 original + purged hashes, audit ID aud_86edfb8f3777, and all 3 download buttons (purged doc, audit PDF, audit JSON). Rotated fixture flow also completes end-to-end with verified badge. No cloud OCR calls observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Iteration 1/2 carry-over minor items still valid (non-blocking): fallback URL 'http://localhost:8001' in App.js violates 'no default URL' guideline; profile_id not validated on upload; no auth on download endpoints. None affect OCR feature correctness.
seed_data_creation: Synthetic OCR fixtures auto-generated by backend/fixtures_generator.generate_all_fixtures (sample_scanned_medical_hr.pdf, sample_rotated_scanned.pdf).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` for full regression (15 tests, ~17s). OCR-specific: test_ocr_pipeline.py covers raster detection, Tesseract text+bbox extraction, physical pixel purge, ocr_reverification_passed flag, rotated 90deg. UI: qa-fixtures-btn -> load-fixture-scanned-btn / load-fixture-rotated-btn -> accept-all-matches-btn -> trigger-purge-modal-btn -> confirm-purge-btn -> download-purged-doc-btn/download-audit-pdf-btn/download-audit-json-btn. OCR-sourced matches show 'Fuente: ocr + regex'.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found. On-premise Tesseract OCR pipeline meets all requirements: raster detection, bbox-based physical pixel purge, re-run OCR verification (verification_engine.verify_pdf with is_scanned=True), rejected-entity preservation, and 'Purga verificada' label only after ocr_reverification_passed.
